reviews.text: Have used Paws for Walks twice now while I’ve been away on vacation. Could not recommend more - I felt that the cat sitters were all excellent at their job and their communication. I felt very, very comfortable being away from home, and that my cat was in great hands!

My dog and I moved to Chicago earlier this year and I chose PFWC to take him on walks on days that I am in-office, and have recently expanded into using PFWC for overnight stays when I travel. We can’t say enough wonderful things about the owners and people who work there. Everyone we have worked with - Maggie, Alyson, Michael, Monika, and Aidyn have exceeded my expectations. They are reliable, communicative, and genuinely kind and caring people. I feel safe leaving my dog, who is anxious by nature, in their care, which I think is the greatest gift a dog mom can receive. They take the time to get to know your dog and are always happy to implement any accommodations that your dog may need. Thank you, PFWC, Shep and I are grateful for you!

We couldn't be happier with Paws for Walks—they are truly top-notch! The entire team is incredibly reliable and responsive, making scheduling and communication seamless.

A massive shout-out and five stars specifically for Monika, who is an absolute gem. Every time she arrives, she is visibly excited to see our dog, which means the world to us. She treats our pup, and we know, all her clients, with genuine love and care. We always receive thorough updates and fun pictures after every walk, and her communication is exceptional.

Best pet care company I have ever used. Super professional and friendly! They have taken care of both my dog, Sophie and my cat, Murphy. They love all the attention they get when they get their visit. Highly recommend using them for any pet care needs!

Kara at Paws for Walks goes above and beyond for the pets she cares for. It’s clear she runs her business with heart and professionalism, and her dedication to the well-being of each dog really shines through. A great choice for any pet family!

Paws for Walks Chicago is the best dog walking/boarding company!! Kara and her staff is amazing. All of them go through extensive training to make sure that your pets have the best care. I highly recommend them for any of your pet needs!!

Hi Gabi (The Reed & The Cooper),
We were surprised to see your review, as you’ve never personally used our pet-care services. While we’ve had the pleasure of caring for several wonderful residents at The Reed who’ve shared great feedback, this review doesn’t reflect their experiences or the quality of our work.
Our team had hoped to participate in your building’s doggy dip event, but due to limited weekend staffing, we had to prioritize our regular clients whose pets rely on us daily. As a small, women-owned business, we always strive to communicate transparently and do right by both our clients and community partners.
We’d greatly appreciate it if you’d consider revising or removing this review, as it doesn’t represent an actual client experience. Thank you for understanding, and we hope to collaborate again in the future when scheduling allows.
Thank you!

Hi Lucy, we take all feedback seriously, but after thoroughly checking our records, we have no record of you ever being a client, contacting us, or using our services. If you believe this is in error, please reach out to us directly so we can look into it further. In the meantime, we kindly ask that reviews reflect actual client experiences, as they are an important resource for our community. Thank you!

We absolutely love Paws for Walks! Monika takes such great care of our dog, Bigos. She gives us detailed updates after every visit (with fun stories and pictures), which always makes us smile and gives us peace of mind. She’s so reliable, caring, and clearly loves what she does. Bigos adores her and looks forward to his walks and playtime. Highly recommend Monika and Paws for Walks to anyone looking for someone trustworthy and loving to care for their pup!
I have had nothing short of perfection with Paws For Walks.  I have loved every walker- and so does my pup- and our current walker Kelly N. is just so amazing.

I can’t say enough great things about Paws For Walk Chicago! Kara and Lesley are truly the best—they care for my dog, Coco, like she’s their own. I trust them and their team completely, and their dedication goes beyond just dog walking. They’ve created such a wonderful sense of community, connecting dog parents and making our neighborhood feel like family. So grateful for them! 🐶❤️

I started using Paws for Walks to help with walks while I was recovering from surgery. They were wonderful- always prompt, reliable, and fabulously enthusiastic to see Arthur. Special shoutout to Michael who was always attentive to Arthur’s quirks and shenanigans! I haven’t meet all of the walkers yet, but I know Arthur has adored each and every one. We also joined a super fun puppy hour event hosted by Paws and it was great to see other local pet and artist businesses! I hope to try some of their training, daycare, and boarding services in the future. &&& of course we love supporting local women-owned businesses!!!

I love Paws for Walks Chicago. I have a senior dog. Monika does an amazing job being creative to make sure she moves around a bit when there’s bad weather or my Rox is being stubborn and won’t go outside or is just moving slow that day but needs movement. I appreciate the pictures, map of walks, treats, potty update etc. It gives me peace of mind knowing my girl was taken care of while I’m working.

We left our dog with PFW for a week and Kara & Lesley took fantastic care of him. He got to play with them and also other dogs and we got lots of pictures. This will be our go-to place from here on out.

The Paws for Walks team is phenomenal. The company is well run, unfailingly reliable and extremely communicative. The whole team goes above and beyond to ensure the very best for the pets in their care. My daily walker Cortney is such a godsend, and I know she cares about my pup as much as I do (which is SO MUCH) :) He’s had a challenging year, and knowing he has Cortney in his corner when I’m away gives me great peace of mind. I am so thankful for Paws for Walks and highly recommend them!

As a first-time dog mom, finding a reliable and caring dog-walking service was a priority for me—and Paws for Walk Chicago exceeded all my expectations! This is the first and only company I’ve used, and I couldn’t be happier.

Their communication is always top-notch, which makes me feel completely comfortable with the team entering my home and taking care of my dog. Dusty is my dog’s primary walker, and when they’re not available, Casey and Maryely step in seamlessly. All of them provide detailed updates about each walk, along with pictures, which gives me peace of mind knowing my dog is in great hands.

I highly recommend Paws for Walk Chicago to anyone looking for trustworthy, professional, and caring dog walkers. They’ve made being a new dog mom so much easier!

Paws for Walks Chicago is the gold standard for pet care.

We were faced with a nightmarish situation while 4,000 miles away from home when our pre-arranged sitter fell through. Our dog trainer works closely with Paws for Walks and helped us get onboarded with them.

Once we hired Paws for Walks we were finally able to disconnect on our first vacation in two years.

Our assigned dog walker Maryely continues to be a dream and we and our dogs adore her! She is patient, caring and kind with them, she takes them on the best walks, takes the cutest pics and videos and it is so obvious how much she loves the pets in her care. What a gem Paws for Walks has in Maryely!

Dusty also walked our pups one day and they both thoroughly enjoyed themselves during their time with Dusty, too! Thank you Dusty!

All Paws for Walks team members send regular photo and video updates each walk, messages to the pawrents, too. Their client portal is terrific. It shows walk routes via GPS and a report of if they did their numbers 1 and 2 and how many treats they ate. Scheduling, invoice paying, vet records updating are all made quick and easy with their app.

Paws for Walks Chicago is caring of both pets and their humans.

We are very proud to support a women and LGBTQ owned, inclusive local business like Paws for Walks Chicago. We are grateful for their care for our family. Thank you Kara and Lesley, Maryely and Dusty for all you do!

The Carbone Family
We have been using Paws for Walks walking services for years and Sammy really like Maryely! I highly recommend this service!
Duke absolutely loves his walker Maggie!! She is the best!

I can't say enough good things about Maryley as our dog walker! She’s incredibly reliable, always on time, and sends updates and pictures from each walk, which gives me such peace of mind. I couldn’t ask for a better walker and would recommend her to anyone looking for someone who truly cares about their dog. Thank you, Maryley, for going above and beyond!"
The best in Chicago! Is like leaving my pup with a close family member. I trust them for everything!

I cannot say enough good things about Paws for Walks! They are wonderful, caring and very communicative. Kind and accommodating also! I love the app it is very easy to use! Highly recommend on behalf of two happy pups!

The whole team was amazing! They were so helpful and patient with all the questions I had for our first time using a dog sitter and accommodating with what we needed. I could tell my pooch, Oliver, had a great time,  got some needed energy out and tons of sniffs :) We would definitely recommend them!

Thank god my friend July recommended you after I asked her which was the best pet care company in our neighborhood, and she wasn’t wrong! 🤩 I’m so thrilled to share my experience with this amazing pet care company! From the moment I reached out, Kara, the owner, was incredibly warm and welcoming. She contacted me right away after my inquiry and took the time to understand both my needs and my dog's personality.

During my dog’s boarding stay, I felt completely at ease knowing that he was in such loving hands. Kara kept me updated with adorable pictures and videos, and it was clear that my pup was having a blast! He came home so happy and content, which is all a pet parent could hope for.

After that wonderful experience, I decided to schedule weekly walks, and I couldn’t be luckier. Kara and her team treat my dog like family, and I love hearing about their adventures together.

Thank you, guys! You have made a huge difference in our lives, and I wholeheartedly recommend your services to anyone looking for top-notch pet care. Penny and I are so grateful to have found you! 🐾❤️

Paws for a walk is one of the worst companies that I’ve ever worked with. They do not care about their clients and they do not care about the pets. They will cancel on you last minute and if you have any issues, they will completely just cut you off versus trying to work together to come to a solution. If you love your pets, stay away from this company, trust me!
I just moved out from Florida to Chicago with my two cats and I never trusted in anyone to take care of my cats but Paws for Walks Chicago has been absolutely amazing taking care of my two Angels

Kara and her team are people who are super dedicated to their work. I trust them and I love that they take good care of my dog ​​Cooper, they have always been loving. I thank them for taking care of my dog.
I recently hired Paws For Walks to walk my dog, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience. From the first contact, their level of professionalism and empathy towards animals was evident. …

Maggie has been wonderful with Colts needs. He enjoys her company when she comes over. She gives him the balance of movement along with just sitting with him building trusts and comfort. This gives me peace of mind as we deal with Colts …

I cannot recommend Paws for Walks highly enough. Kara and Lesley provide exceptional care for my senior dog while boarding him, and he is always excited to see them. They are professional and reliable, and I feel that they truly care about …
